ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are sorry to hear your grill is not reaching 500 degrees. It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. 
If you do activate the gas regulator safety device, the grill may struggle to reach high temperatures or may not light at all, even with all burners on the START/HIGH setting.

To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.


If you continue to experience an issue after going through the following steps, please contact our support team for further assistance. We would be happy to help. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText:
When time to replace our beloved 28 year old (!!) Weber genesis, obvious choice: another Weber. But things have changed. 
Yes, went from a Genesis to Spirit solely on price/affordability. 
First, the burners now run left, middle, right, not front, middle, back. This changes the cooking game tremendously; from whole chicken roasting, to pizza on the grill. Both almost annoyingly impossible. 
Second, the entire metal cabinet is unnecessary. Replacing a full, heavy, awkward tank is very difficult to lift into the cabinet and hook into the hanger. The gas gauge is cool though.   
There is no longer a slide out bottom clean out tray...please bring that back!
Gone is a front foldable shelf that was ideal when cooking for a crowd. Weber designers reduced the profile of hooks to hang spatulas etc soo low, that a pair of tongs won’t remain in place without falling... and they are on the side, not the front of the shelf? Thankfully they moved knobs off the side shelf to the front, gaining real estate there is a score. 
Lastly, there is no longer a hole in the front of the grill to light it old school if *battery* ignition fails. Whyyy?
All in all, its a box that cooks food on my deck, that’s how disenfranchised we are. .. more than a bit of a let down after the long love affair we had with our old one.
Results.Title: Underwhelmed

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill to replace an earlier Weber grill of the same model that had finally worn out. We assembled this grill ourselves and the step by step instructions were easy to follow. Weber has made a number of improvements since our old model came out. For example, if you have to replace the regulator hose, it attaches in a much more accessible location. Burner controls are now on the front, instead of on a side shelf, providing much more shelf space. The igniter box is in a better location, making it more effective in lighting the grill quickly. Finally, the propane tank mounts on a type of scale that, based on the weight, enables you to monitor how much propane is left in the tank. Previously, we had to disconnect the tank and take it out and weigh it to determine the amount of remaining propane. The only negative we found is that it's VERY hard to remove and replace the tank due to the difficulty of removing or replacing the heavy tank on the mount where it attaches to the level indicator.

It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
